lines.text: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion.
It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
so the LORD surrounds His people,
For the scepter of the wicked will not rest
upon the land allotted to the righteous,
so that the righteous will not put forth
Do good, O LORD, to those who are good,
and to the upright in heart.
But those who turn to crooked ways
the LORD will banish with the evildoers.

pictures.scene: Thomas Hill, Yosemite - the great rounded granite dome standing above the sheer cliffs with the waterfall dropping in two long stages down the rock face and the dark pines massed along the valley below it, a song of ascents, those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, it cannot be moved, it abides forever
pictures.name: pd_hill_berg

pictures.scene: Johann Gustav Grunewald, Landscape, Tirol - the still lake lying in the ring of peaks that close around it on every side, the chalets set on the green slope at the right and the man in the hat walking up with his staff, the warm dusk light filling the whole basin, as the mountains surround Jerusalem so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore
pictures.name: pd_grunewald_omringd

pictures.scene: Robert Zund, Ahrenfeld - the ripe gold wheat standing to the path with the tall green trees above it and the white clouds in the blue sky, the old man in the red waistcoat with his stick and the young woman in the blue skirt walking the field path, the harvesters and the hay stack out in the distance, for the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous
pictures.name: pd_zund_akker

pictures.scene: Nicolaes Maes, De spinster - the old woman seated at her spinning wheel with both hands laid to the thread and her white collar and red sleeves lit against the bare white wall, the pewter standing on the shelf and the red cloth on the table beside her, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice
pictures.name: pd_maes_handen

pictures.scene: Meester van Alkmaar, De zeven werken van barmhartigheid - the rich man in the red robe pouring out drink on the steps for the thirsty, the crippled man leaning on his crutches and the boy kneeling for the cup and the woman holding up her pewter jug, and Christ standing quietly among the poor, do good O LORD to those who are good, and to the upright in heart
pictures.name: pd_alkmaar_weldoen

pictures.scene: Narcisse Diaz de la Pena, Paysage - the sandy track winding away up the heath between the grey boulders and the rough green turf, the tall orange leaved tree standing over it and the heavy grey sky worked thick above, and the one small figure in the white cap going off along the path, but those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers
pictures.name: pd_diaz_kronkelpad

pictures.scene: Fitz Henry Lane, Owl's Head, Penobscot Bay, Maine - the bay lying flat as glass under the rose and gold light with the schooner at rest and her sails hanging slack, the low wooded shore and the white houses along it and the far blue hills, and the man in the straw hat standing on the rocks with his pole looking out over the still water, peace be upon Israel
pictures.name: pd_lane_vrede
